description: Base config without automerge: recommended defaults, pinned GitHub Actions digests, daily lock file maintenance, semantic commits, one grouped PR for patch and stable minor updates, monorepo grouping and a 3/5/7-day release age for patch/minor/major.

packageRules.description: No release timestamps available: pinning is safer than leaving unpinned
No release timestamps available: lock file maintenance refreshes many packages at once, so without this it would stay pending under timestamp-required (automerge)
No release timestamps available: registries and datasources that do not expose them
No release timestamps on GHCR: allow the zizmor image through

Do not update the composer php platform requirement: it is not a package, so Composer cannot update it in composer.lock (the lock update fails and the content-hash goes stale). The minimum PHP version is a project decision: change it by hand
One PR per repo for every patch update. Overrides group:monorepos for patches
Add minor updates of stable (>= 1.0) dependencies to the same PR. 0.x minors keep their own PRs: a group is automerged only if every update in it is, and 0.x minors are never automerged

Trial set of PR table columns, for every update (Current value, New value and Package file already removed). Overrides the narrower set from config:recommended (mergeConfidence:age-confidence-badges). Delete the lines you do not need.
